query: Are Hot Rod and The Memory of Our People both magazines?

The magazine "The Memory of Our People", published in Rosario, Argentina, was founded in 2004 by a group of Argentinean car enthusiasts who wanted to share their passion for hot rodding with the world. It is a monthly publication that focuses on hot rodding and drag racing. The magazine's title is "La Memoria de Nuestro Pueblo".
